title: Select and materialize persistence deltas through dirty indexes rather than all sessions
outcome: Background persistence selects changed sessions and delegations through maintained dirty state and materializes them by key, so an idle or small-change tick does not scan all retained sessions or perform changed-count times total-session lookups.
acceptance: Delta selection is proportional to changed sessions and delegations rather than scanning every retained session and delegation on each persistence tick
Materialization uses keyed lookup rather than a linear session or delegation search per changed record
Unchanged, changed, removed and racing records retain their current persistence and trim behavior, with a large-history regression demonstrating bounded work
